result.stdout:
usage: nugate check [path] [--config <file>] [--json] [--min-age-days <N>]
       nugate --help | --version

nugate enforces a dependency age policy for resolved NuGet packages.

Commands:
  check [path]          Scan restore outputs under [path] (default: current directory)

Options:
  --config <file>       Path to nugate.json (default: nugate.json at [path])
  --json                Emit machine-readable JSON on stdout
  --min-age-days <N>    Override minAgeDays from config
  -h, --help            Show this help
  --version             Show version

Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 policy violations, 2 operational error.
